instruments.notes: Float-for-fixed gas swaps, cash flow hedges of anticipated 2003-2005 gas sales. Aggregate disclosure only: no per-swap volume or price. Count differs in text: eight (MD&A) vs five (liquidity section, Dec 31 2003). Hedges (swaps and collars together) were 11% of 2003 produced sales volumes at avg $4.10/Mcf and expected 24% of 2004 volumes at avg $5.17/Mcf. Fair value reported only for the combined gas hedge portfolio: loss of $5.4MM net of $3.5MM deferred tax; or OCI loss $3.6MM net of $2.3MM tax.

instruments.notes: Two float-for-collar gas swap transactions, cash flow hedges. No floor/ceiling strikes or volumes disclosed. Combined hedge averages: 11% of 2003 produced sales volumes at $4.10/Mcf; 24% of expected 2004 volumes at $5.17/Mcf (swaps and collars not split out).
instruments.evidence_quote: These cash flow hedges are expected to represent 24% of our estimated 2004 produced sales volumes at an average price of $5.17 per thousand cubic feet.

hedging_summary.stated_hedging_policy: Uses fixed-price contracts, collar-price contracts and derivative commodity instruments (cash-flow hedges under SFAS 133) to minimize gas price volatility; policy prohibits speculative derivatives; none held for trading.
